questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: The "Sun Temple" at Konark is located in which state?
questions.explanation: The Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha.

questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: The hardest natural substance known is:
questions.explanation: Diamond is the hardest known natural substance.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.explanation: The CAG is appointed by the President of India.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:

questions.question: Which river is the longest in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile is generally regarded as the longest river in the world.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: Which is the smallest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.explanation: Iron is essential for haemoglobin formation.

questions.question: The author of the Indian national anthem is:

questions.question: Which amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?

questions.question: Which is the largest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the drafting committee.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?

questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: Who decides the repo rate in India?
questions.explanation: The RBI sets the repo rate through its Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.explanation: A Lok Sabha term is normally 5 years.

questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is a men’s international badminton team event.

questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the last and only Indian Governor-General.
